title: Skip overlap marking for a duplicate or abandoned command finish
outcome: From tm-winf round-12 review (Claude, Low). note_engram_command_finished always marks other sessions' open checks overlapped (engram_mark_checks_overlapped_by), even for a duplicate finish (the Codex legacy item_completed mirror after the typed v2 completion) or a finish after an abandon (declined Codex command). Neither writes anything new; the only effect is extra pessimism (another session's test becomes unknown). Note running_command_keys is only populated in mediated sessions, so 'key not running' cannot be the test for an unmediated writer; a per-session set of finished/abandoned keys (or a finish-dedup) would be needed.
